title: PaymentOrderSummary
description: Aggregate summary response from GET /api/merchants/{merchantId}/payment-orders/summary. All four top-level fields are always present; byCurrency and byStatus may be empty arrays when no matching orders exist.

totalOrders.description: Total number of payment orders matching the query filter

totalAmountMinor.description: Sum of amountMinor across all matching payment orders

byCurrency.description: Aggregate breakdown per ISO-4217 currency, ordered ASC by currency string

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code (e.g. PLN, EUR, USD)

orderCount.description: Number of orders with this currency in the result set

totalAmountMinor.description: Sum of amountMinor for orders with this currency

byStatus.description: Aggregate breakdown per lifecycle status, ordered ASC by status string

status.description: Lifecycle status (CREATED | AUTHORIZED | CAPTURED | CANCELLED | REFUNDED)

orderCount.description: Number of orders with this status in the result set

totalAmountMinor.description: Sum of amountMinor for orders with this status

_note: additionalProperties: false on both the root and nested item schemas. If the backend adds fields (e.g. currencyCode vs currency), this schema fails intentionally. Phase 8H.
